Needs changes before merge.

The theme keys have clamp limits. The consumers read the new tokens. The tests cover the status height, tab spacing, window margin, and drop hint.

Local results:

The trial merge with upstream/main at 7ce792b8672194613a3d2c87060422fd7e953b0a succeeded. All commands ran locally in `.claude/worktrees/review-2091`. No GitHub runner was used.

- Build: `cargo test -j 6 -p camcraft-ui --lib --test boundary --test boundary_picks --test sinker_setup --test theme_files --test theme_shell_metrics --test waterjet_tool --no-run` passed.
- UI library: 867 passed, 0 failed, 6 ignored. This includes the three new structural tests for #2064.
- Integration suites ran separately: boundary 3, boundary_picks 6, sinker_setup 2, theme_files 14, theme_shell_metrics 2, waterjet_tool 1. All 28 tests passed.
- `cargo clippy -j 6 -p camcraft-ui --all-targets -- -D warnings` passed with no warnings.
- The quick gate plan was inspected. The full quick gate was not run. Its plan includes changes from main because the trial merge has no commit.

Requested before merge:

1. `crates/ui/src/egui_app/file_drop.rs:65` and the other changed UI consumers: the PR body has no before/after screenshots. Add screenshot pairs that show the affected UI. Include the status strip, ribbon tabs, window margin, and file drop hint. Store the images only on the fork's images-only `pr-screenshots` branch. Link them from the PR body. Do not add images or review evidence to this PR branch.

Notes:

- I found no code blocker.
- The PR does not change posted G-code, gouge checks, collision checks, stock simulation, or model geometry. A safety-tier review is not required.
- No golden files changed in the PR diff. Pixel snapshot tests were not run.
- I did not repeat the author's mutation checks. The five pinning tests passed on the restored code.
- The PR remains a draft because the screenshot requirement is not met.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.

The requested screenshot evidence is now in the PR body.

Four before/after pairs show the status strip, ribbon tabs, window margin, and file drop hint.
The images are on the fork's `pr-screenshots` branch at `b2dad955c2be0593f0212e4bf223e7242b46ea0a`.
The PR body states the capture method and theme values.
No code or evidence files were added to this PR branch.

Check: `pr2091-check-evidence.py` verifies all eight links, PNG files, dimensions, and changed pixels.
The original body fails. Each missing-link mutation fails. The restored body passes.

The quick gate and UI clippy pass.
The PR head remains `bacb784b0207c43ea610bb8da9c8beb15f9ba61b` because this finding requires only PR evidence.

Please review this PR again.

The code and screenshot review is clean. The PR conflicts with current main.

This is a review of the same head after the author's later evidence comment.
I withdraw the screenshot request in my previous review.

Local results:

The trial merge with upstream/main at `780b0a25a40606dc3cc96f56ab0b2c8ecb1093e6` failed.
I aborted the merge without resolving code conflicts.
The checks below ran on the PR head in `.claude/worktrees/review-2091`, not on a merged tree.
All commands ran locally in the foreground. No GitHub runner was used.

- Quick gate dry-run: passed. It selected the UI library and six integration suites.
- Build: `cargo test -j 6 -p camcraft-ui --lib --test boundary --test boundary_picks --test sinker_setup --test theme_files --test theme_shell_metrics --test waterjet_tool --no-run` passed.
- UI library: 832 passed, 0 failed, 6 ignored.
- Separate integration runs: boundary 3, boundary_picks 6, sinker_setup 2, theme_files 14, theme_shell_metrics 2, waterjet_tool 1. All 28 tests passed.
- `cargo clippy -j 6 -p camcraft-ui --all-targets -- -D warnings`: passed with no warnings.

Requested code or evidence changes: none.

- `crates/ui/src/egui_app/tests/ribbon_rows.rs`
- `crates/ui/src/egui_app/theme.rs`

The `conflicts` label records this state. Refresh the branch only when it is next in a merge batch, under the current rules.
A merged-tree test result is still required after that refresh.

The PR changes UI layout metrics. It does not change posted G-code, gouge checks, collision checks, stock simulation, or model geometry.
A safety-tier review is not required. I did not repeat the author's mutation checks.
The five tests for #2064 passed on the unchanged PR head.
No golden files changed. Pixel snapshot tests did not run.
I checked the laws against current upstream main's `AGENTS.md`.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.

Merge-time refresh (AGENTS.md "Refresh only at merge time"): this PR is in the next merge batch. Its parent #2027 has merged, so the conflict is only main moving. Requested change for the mergefix: merge `upstream/main` into the branch (no rebase), keep both sides, re-run the quick gate, push, and ask for a re-review. No other changes.

Merged `upstream/main` at `af83da0f405cfd244f0c9bf8192ab7309e9db824` to resolve the reported conflicts.
Kept both theme token sets, parser entries, clamp checks, and tests.
Kept main's extracted clamp and token-name modules.

The test `merged_shell_and_main_geometry_keep_overrides_clamps_and_refusals` checks both token sets together.
It also checks main's font clamp and unknown-token refusal.
Removing main's font registration made the test fail.
Removing the PR's shell registrations made the test fail.
The restored code passed.

`cargo xtask gate quick --base upstream/main` passed: 942 tests passed, 6 ignored.
UI clippy passed for all targets with `-D warnings`.
The clippy retry used no compiler cache wrapper after the first run stalled.

New head: `d6aecb1c9fd95f776ba862a005e3756caf557c72`.
The PR remains a draft. No review evidence files were added to this branch.

Please review this PR again. It is ready for a re-check.

<!-- pr-reviewer: d6aecb1c9fd95f776ba862a005e3756caf557c72 -->
Ready for the maintainer to merge.

The merge resolutions keep both theme token sets, parser entries, clamp checks, and tests.
The combined parser test checks overrides, clamps, and refusal of an unknown token.
I checked the resolutions with `git show --remerge-diff`.
I checked the laws against current upstream main's `AGENTS.md` and UI rules.

Local results:

The trial merge with upstream/main at `af83da0f405cfd244f0c9bf8192ab7309e9db824` succeeded: main is already in this head.
All checks ran locally in `.claude/worktrees/review-2091`, with its own target directory.
No GitHub runner was used. No code was changed.

- Quick gate dry-run: passed. I ran its selected suites separately below.
- Build with `cargo test -j 6 -p camcraft-ui --lib --test boundary --test boundary_picks --test sinker_setup --test tap_hand --test theme_files --test theme_shell_metrics --test waterjet_tool --no-run`: passed.
- UI library, final full run: 909 passed, 0 failed, 6 ignored.
- Separate integration runs: boundary 3, boundary_picks 6, sinker_setup 2, tap_hand 3, theme_files 15, theme_shell_metrics 3, waterjet_tool 1. All 33 tests passed.
- `cargo clippy -j 6 -p camcraft-ui --all-targets -- -D warnings`: passed with no warnings.

The first library run had 908 passes and one failure in `egui_app::tests::ai_chat::safety::post_confirmation_allow_and_deny_gate_mcp_dispatch`.
The failure came from `crates/ui/src/egui_app/tests/ai_chat/mod.rs:84`:

```text
Harness::run exceeded max_steps (4).
```

The named test passed on its own. The repeated full library run also passed.
This appears to be an intermittent harness repaint limit. I found no reproducible blocker.
The cache wrapper stalled during gate planning, so the completed checks used `RUSTC_WRAPPER=`.
One build attempt ended with signal 143 during dependency compilation. The restarted build passed.

Requested before merge: none.

Evidence and scope:

- All eight screenshot links load. I inspected the four before/after pairs for the status strip, ribbon tabs, window margin, and file drop hint.
- The PR body describes the theme values and the temporary capture method. The earlier screenshot request is met.
- The PR diff contains no screenshot, log, or review evidence files. The image links use the fork's screenshot commit.
- The PR changes UI layout metrics. It does not change posted G-code, gouge checks, collision checks, stock simulation, or model geometry.
- A safety-tier review is not required. I did not repeat the author's mutations. The added tests passed.
- No golden files changed. Pixel snapshot tests did not run.

Non-blocking note: `crates/ui/src/egui_app/theme.rs:93` adds fields to a file that grows from 400 to 428 lines.
A later split can keep this file near the size guideline.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.
